verdict.rationale: LanceDB Enterprise documents client authentication to remote `db://` tables using API keys, described as a long-lived shared secret that works in every SDK, or OAuth 2.0. The pack shows no evidence of roles, RBAC, or per-table/per-collection permissions, so authentication is covered but granular authorization is not. Missing for 10: role-based access control, per-table/collection permission scoping, scoped or least-privilege API keys, any authorization docs beyond authentication, and independent corroboration.
